plugins.name: paideia
plugins.description: Exam-prep workspace for math/physics courses, antigravity-native. 16 skills + a bundled stdio MCP server (paideia-mcp) that owns parallel vision ingest, OCR (antigravity-native via Antigravity CLI's bundled vision / Qwen3-VL / Tesseract), strategy-grading, draft course-index generation, and phase detection. All artifacts are plain markdown. /paideia-alt imports an OPTIMETA Exam Radar export so lecture-emphasis exam signal folds in beside HW density.
